BiblicalUsage: Dilean was one of the cities in the lowlands of Judah, named in the allotment Joshua set out for the tribe. Its site is uncertain today, and the name itself means gourd.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe even a town whose stones are lost still belongs in the record, because God gave His people a real land with real borders.
